decisions.reason: Kimwolf v7 Android/IoT botnet evolution: HTTP/2 flood with Chrome-like fingerprint spoofing (nghttp2), targets Android TV/set-top boxes, tied to AISURU operation, identified Feb 3 2026. Same botnet as the existing canonical Kimwolf story, not a new incident.

Phantom Stealer .NET infostealer campaigns via phishing, cracked software, Discord/Telegram; steals browser credentials, cookies, crypto wallets on Windows; steganographic loaders and PowerShell->explorer.exe injection. Real malware campaign intel, no existing story covers it.
